note: ひゅーどろどろ is the stock Japanese sound for a ghost appearing: an eerie flute (ひゅー) and a drum roll (どろどろ), taken from kabuki stage music. The English game put a howl, "Awooh!", instead.
claim: In kabuki, ghosts appear to a flute and a drum roll, imitated in Japanese as hyū-dorodoro.

check.quote: お化けの出るシーンでは、ドロドロドロドロと大太鼓の音、ヒュ～と笛の音が入るとあっという間におどろおどろしい雰囲気を作り上げます。
